scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Papita Vikas Yojana
description: The 'Papita Vikas Yojana' is a component of the umbrella scheme 'Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission' launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar. The scheme promotes commercial papaya cultivation across all districts of Bihar by providing financial assistance and high-quality tissue-cultured plants. It encourages inclusive participation through reserved quotas for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women farmers. Financial assistance is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), and both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible.
objectives: Promote commercial cultivation of papaya across Bihar.
Increase horticultural production and farmers' income.
Provide financial assistance for papaya cultivation.
Encourage participation of SC, ST, and women farmers.

benefits.title: Financial Assistance - First Year
benefits.description: ₹33,750 per hectare is provided during the first year of papaya cultivation.

benefits.title: Financial Assistance - Second Year
benefits.description: ₹11,250 per hectare is provided during the second year of cultivation.

benefits.title: Supply of Tissue-Cultured Plants
benefits.description: Eligible beneficiaries receive high-quality tissue-cultured papaya plants.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Farmer
eligibility.description: The applicant should be a farmer.

eligibility.title: Land Requirement
eligibility.description: The applicant must possess agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 0.25 acres (0.1 hectare) to a maximum of 10 acres (4 hectares).

eligibility.title: DBT Registration
eligibility.description: The applicant must be registered on the Agriculture Department DBT Portal.

registration_steps.title: Visit DBT Portal
registration_steps.description: Visit the Agriculture Department DBT registration portal.

registration_steps.title: Authenticate Aadhaar
registration_steps.description: Select Aadhaar verification mode (OTP/BIO-AUTH/IRIS), enter Aadhaar details, and authenticate.

registration_steps.title: Validate OTP
registration_steps.description: Enter the OTP received on the registered mobile number and validate it.

registration_steps.title: Confirm KCC Details
registration_steps.description: Confirm the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) details.

registration_steps.title: Complete Farmer Registration
registration_steps.description: Fill farmer details, land information, bank account details, submit the application, validate OTP, and generate the 13-digit Registration ID.

application_steps.title: Proceed to Apply
application_steps.description: Scroll to the bottom, confirm the checkbox, and click 'Proceed to Apply'.

application_steps.title: Enter Registration Details
application_steps.description: Select the applicant type, enter the 13-digit DBT Registration Number, and fetch the details.

application_steps.title: Fill Application Form
application_steps.description: Enter address, land details, and other required information.

application_steps.title: Upload Documents
application_steps.description: Upload all the required supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Submit Application
application_steps.description: Accept the declaration and submit the application.

application_steps.title: Save Application Number
application_steps.description: Note the generated application number and print the submitted application for future reference.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Details
documents_required.remarks: Aadhaar should be linked with the registered mobile number.

documents_required.name: Land Ownership / Revenue Receipt
documents_required.remarks: If ownership details are unclear, genealogy documents must also be attached.

important_notes: Beneficiary allocation: General Category - 78.56%, Scheduled Castes - 20%, Scheduled Tribes - 1.44%, Women - 30%.
Both ryot and non-ryot farmers are eligible.
Non-ryot farmers must submit a valid contract form.
Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis.
Applications can be submitted only after 48 hours of successful DBT registration.
